name: Compass Net
summary: Sydney dialup ISP (Bankstown POP); defunct ~2007, compassnet.com.au later reused by Volunteer Marine Rescue NSW's 'CompassNet' (Compass Network Pty Ltd, ACN 149 872 944, reg 2011).

events.details: Dialup (PPP/SLIP/UNIX shell); listed in the Cynosure ISP directory as early as 10 Apr 1997.

Dialup ISP wound down (still Cynosure-listed to mid-2005); compassnet.com.au subsequently reused by Volunteer Marine Rescue NSW's 'CompassNet' marine-radio service under Compass Network Pty Ltd (ABN 93 149 872 944, registered 16 Mar 2011 — well after the ISP, so a distinct reuse entity, not a continuation).

refs.label: ABR: Compass Network Pty Ltd ACN 149 872 944 (unrelated later-reuse entity, reg 2011, not the ISP)
